findings.title: Reconcile default theme falls back to inheritedTheme only
findings.message: When no theme is passed, reconcile now falls back to previous.inheritedTheme. Only the root record is consulted. If the root has its own Theme, inheritedTheme holds the parent's theme and the scope is re-derived from the node. That is fine, but for records created by older paths or mountScoped, inheritedTheme may be the zero value, so an update without an explicit theme resets styling to an empty theme. Nodes mounted outside reconcile (for example mountScoped) may never set inheritedTheme.
findings.suggestion: Make sure every record-creation path sets inheritedTheme. Alternatively, fall back to previous.theme when inheritedTheme is unset and the node has no Theme.
